text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Commencing Mission: Birthday Party.
Happy
birthday, Rice.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you, Bourbon. But if you're
with me,
you'll only be struck with
misfortune—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Beep. Inappropriate word detected:
"misfortune."
Strike one activated. Two
strikes left until
self-destruct sequence
activates.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
H-huh?! You mean... if I say the word

"misfortune," then Bourbon... you'll
explode?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Beep. Inappropriate word detected
again. One
strike left until—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! I-I did it again! No... I don't want
to see you
blow up!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon... I've always looked up to you.
I mean,
you're super fast and super
tough!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I love everything about you, Bourbon!
Please
don't explode!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A-are you okay, Bourbon? I didn't say
another
inappropriate word, did I?  Oh
no... What if...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My self-destruct sequence has been put
on hold.
However... my happiness levels
are exploding.
